findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` instead of rejecting access. Any caller relying on this authorization check can therefore disclose documents across tenant boundaries.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now grants access unconditionally. Any request where `userTenant !== documentTenant` is incorrectly authorized, enabling cross-tenant document access.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body:
Any request where `userTenant !== documentTenant` is now authorized because the function unconditionally returns `true`, allowing cross-tenant document disclosure wherever this access check is enforced.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
